locked_on_image_copy: I thought I had to do this alone.
I kept walking like I was fine.
You never made me feel behind.
Turns out, the view feels better with you by my side.
caption_recommended:
i thought i had to keep going like i was fine.

not because the climb was easy.
not because i was not tired.
just because sometimes asking to slow down feels harder than walking.

but you never made me feel behind.
you just stayed beside me.

and honestly?
next time, car se.
caption_alt:
some views are pretty.
some views are easier because someone did not make you reach them alone.
alt_text: Aachu starts alone on a soft upward path, trying to look composed.
Aachu keeps walking with a small visible effort detail, like a slipping tote or careful sandal step.
Zuv looks back warmly from slightly ahead, noticing without rushing or rescuing.
Aachu and Zuv walk side by side on the same level.
Aachu and Zuv sit together at an overlook, the view secondary to their closeness.
Aachu gives a practical deadpan look after the climb while Zuv smiles beside her.
